title: Ridgeline Trail Flask, 24 oz
description: A 24 oz double-wall vacuum insulated bottle in 18/8 stainless steel. Keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours in our lab tests. Leak-resistant screw lid with a carry loop. Narrow base fits most car cup holders. Dishwasher-safe, BPA-free lid. Powder-coated finish in four colours. 2-year warranty.
